title: Skills optimization flight — the four small internal skills (+ objectui `verify`): seven dead references, three rules copied from os-dev.md / SWEEP.md / RUNNER.md, the `live-elsewhere` gap (#14058), and a versioned Chromium path that breaks on the next image bump
body:
Member card of the skills catalog optimization program #14292 (maintainer mandate 2026-09-02, verbatim: 「审核所有的 skills，进行全面的优化。」). Filed by the skills lane seat (session `session_01LraLgQVGq8egUwfYZpbYt1`). Read-only audit at objectstack `origin/main` a59f78d (`.claude/skills/**` and `scripts/pm/**` byte-identical at d63c8a25) and objectui 67dadd6. The auditor's harness refused to write a findings file; the findings are recorded here (the dev posts the seat's full audit message as the audit-record comment at claim time — provided in the dispatch brief). **Family dispatch**: this card also closes **#14058** (the `live-elsewhere` verdict gap in `spec-property-retirement`) — same file, same fix (SPR-C-05); #14058 keeps its own claim comment pointing at this branch.

## Verdicts

| skill | ceiling (lines) | verdict | reducible |
|---|---|---|---|
| `checklist-author` | 62 | RESTRUCTURE | ~15 of 44 body lines are a second copy of `SWEEP.md` |
| `checklist-test` | 238 | TRIM | ~15 lines |
| `dogfood-verification` | 157 | DIET | ~25 lines |
| `spec-property-retirement` | 337 | DIET | ~35 lines + 4 dead refs + 1 blocking gap |
| objectui `.claude/skills/verify` | (unpriced, unguarded) | HEALTHY | one fix |

None is a retirement candidate. All four objectstack skills carry `metadata.internal: true` (enforced by `packages/create-objectstack/src/template-consistency.test.ts:601`). Usage cadence is not measurable on a shallow clone (dimension E recorded NOT MEASURED).

## Findings (id · span · fix)

- **SPR-C-01** `spec-property-retirement:329-332` — "`check-generated` runs behind a `paths` filter in `ci.yml`; add the path in the same PR": that job and filter were deleted (`lint.yml:3949,4078` "gone (#4291)"; `ci.yml` has no `paths:`); `AGENTS.md:724-726` states the current truth. DELETE −4.
- **DOG-C-01** `dogfood:66-83` (18 lines) — the ablation predict-then-mutate rule duplicates `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:274-283` (same criterion, same `KNOWN_UNALIASED_TEST_IMPORTS` ledger, same two incidents); both texts say the rule is not dogfood's. MERGE-INTO os-dev.md (pointer, 2 lines). −16.
- **CLA-C-01** `checklist-author:33-51` — opens 「本技能…不是流程的第二份拷贝」 then restates `SWEEP.md:48-68` steps 2–6 one-for-one + SWEEP's angle table. REWRITE to the 3 clauses SWEEP lacks + pointer. −13.
- **SPR-D-01** `spec-property-retirement:316-337` — 4 of 7 traps duplicate a binding anchor (stale-`dist` = `AGENTS.md:764-767`; `| tail -1` = `os-dev.md:140-141`; sequential masking = `AGENTS.md:725-729` and the skill's own `:28-31`; `--check` vs bare = `AGENTS.md:754-758`). Keep the two unique ones. −10.
- **SPR-C-05 (= #14058)** — the ledger grew a fifth verdict `live-elsewhere` (`packages/spec/liveness/README.md:63-64,262-308`; gate `packages/spec/scripts/liveness/elsewhere.test.ts`; 1 live row of 703): the skill has zero hits for it; §0's four-question checklist and §1's 「dead 裁定是删除的输入」 predate it. ADD a fifth §0 checkbox naming the never-remove cross-repo case, paid by SPR-C-01 + SPR-C-04.
- **CLT-B-01** `checklist-test:78-87` — 「解析器给出的 `automated.ref`」 is false: `scripts/checklist-select.mjs:180` projects `{id,priority,surface,since,revision}`; the field lives only in `areas/*.json`, so the Tier-1 batching step is unexecutable as written. Fix the step to read the field from the area file.
- **SPR-C-02** `spec-property-retirement:81` — the strict-delete route describes a hand-written `z.core.$ZodErrorMap`; superseded by #6805: `shared/strict-object.ts:125-137,257-312` `guidance:` template, audited by `alias-integrity.test.ts`. Rewrite to name both files.
- **SPR-C-04** `spec-property-retirement:300-311` — a hand-rolled 10-name `check:*` loop is the "match by hand" `AGENTS.md:742-750` forbids; the skill cites AGENTS.md at `:255`. REWRITE to `check:generated` + only the pure audits. −8.
- **VFY-C-01** objectui `verify:26-29` — prescribes `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1194/chrome-linux/chrome`; both siblings prescribe the alias `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium` and warn against exactly this spelling (`RUNNER.md:151-160`; `os-dev.md:142-143`). Fix (objectui PR).
- **DOG-F-01** `dogfood:31-43` — `RUNNER.md:186-208` names dogfood §0 as the origin of the `-p <port>`-alone trap (self-pinging connectors dial 3000 via `SHOWCASE_SELF_URL`→`OS_PORT`→`PORT`); `grep OS_PORT` over dogfood → 0. ADD 2 lines, paid by DOG-C-01.
- **CLT-C-01** `checklist-test:96-97` — 「派发 runner 子代理时,必须用 `opus`」 is a memory-sourced blanket tier; pm-dispatch requires 「档位引当次 `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` 输出,⛔ 不凭记忆」. Rewrite to the `--tier` rule.
- **CLA-C-02** `checklist-author:46-49` — 「六条 waiver 有四条已过期」 is the oldest of three disagreeing numbers; `SWEEP.md:76-86` says 6 of 6 retired and `check-platform-checklist.mjs` reports "0 waived". Fix.
- **SPR-C-03** `:313-314` lists 3 of the 5 no-generator audits `AGENTS.md:765-770` names · **SPR-C-06** `:145` 「~28 个墓碑」 vs 178 `retiredKey(` sites and a pin floor of 50 · **SPR-F-01** §4's changeset row omits the ADR-0087 disposition marker `AGENTS.md:1122-1131` requires (`pnpm check:adr-0087-registration` enforces) · **CLT-C-02/C-03** `:229-235`, `:102-105` re-copy RUNNER rules 1–2 despite `:24-25` disclaiming a second copy (and `:230` claims a precedence `RUNNER.md:67` denies) · **X-02** the no-subagent degradation clause is stated twice near-verbatim (`checklist-author:58-62` / `checklist-test:98-101`, both from #14152 — keep ONE, note the maintainer provenance in the PR).
- **Dead references** (positive-controlled): `SPR:103 scripts/liveness/orphans.mts` → `packages/spec/scripts/liveness/orphans.mts` · `SPR:261 packages/cli/src/utils/lint-liveness-properties.ts` → `packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.ts` · `SPR:282 .changeset/tool-inert-keys-removed.md` → consumed at release; cite a live `*-retired.md` carrying "The retirement kit:" · `SPR:329-332` (above) · `CLA:42` README's "deep-test 契约" → `README.md:42 ## Item anatomy` · `CLT:78-87` (above). Incidental (non-skill, report only): `SWEEP.md:68` "land the run record under `runs/`" vs `runs/.gitignore` = `*`; `.claude/launch.json:18-33` `pr3505-attach-3477` points at a worktree that does not exist.
- **X-01 (structural, decide in-flight by pointer)**: environment facts are split between `checklist-test:27-29`→dogfood and `RUNNER.md:94-260` (7 facts dogfood lacks, incl. `OS_PORT`; one stated more fully). Rule: RUNNER.md is the environment anchor; dogfood §0 points at it and carries only what RUNNER does not; ⛔ no second copy.

## Flight scope

**IMPLEMENT**: every item above, as TWO PRs — objectstack (`.claude/skills/{checklist-author,checklist-test,dogfood-verification,spec-property-retirement}/SKILL.md`, shrink-only under the line ratchet; ⛔ do not touch `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` — it is held by PR #14236; headroom that appears is re-locked in the corpus audit's Phase 3) and objectui (`.claude/skills/verify/SKILL.md`, one path fix). `Fixes #<this card>` and `Fixes #14058` both on the objectstack PR.

**DEFER / report-only**: the two incidental non-skill items (file as out-of-scope cards if not already carded); X-02's maintainer provenance (#14152) is noted, not re-litigated.

## Flight constraints (binding)

- Draft PRs, governed (`.claude/**` in both repos) ⇒ stay draft; review requests are the seat's step; `skip-changeset` in objectstack (docs-only); objectui: empty-frontmatter changeset only if its rule asks, ⛔ never request a label.
- Line ratchet: no ratcheted file may grow; additions paid by deletions in the same file; ⛔ re-wrap is not payment.
- ⛔ Do not edit `os-dev.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `RUNNER.md`, `SWEEP.md` — they are the anchors; a pointer replaces the copy.
- Gates: `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync`, `pnpm check:skill-frame-freshness`, the `packages/create-objectstack` template-consistency test, plus `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands <changed paths>`; record the head sha.
- PR body: per-item 落点 | before | after keyed by finding id; line delta per file; `Clause-②: no`.

Refs: #14292 · #14058 (folded) · #14232 (separate: unlocks at #12800's close) · #13597 (the pm-dispatch corpus — ⛔ not touched by this flight).
